description: List the largest symbols in one build of a target, optionally filtered by region, section, source file, object or name, or totalled per section, library, object, file or directory with 'group_by'. Use it to see what takes the space.

details.description: Add address, binding, line, object and archive to each symbol (default false).

file_contains.description: Only symbols whose source file path contains this text (case-insensitive).

group_by.description: Return totals per group instead of symbols. 'section' sizes whole sections, including string literals no symbol names ('unnamed_bytes'); name_contains then matches the section name.

name_contains.description: Only symbols whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

object_contains.description: Only symbols whose archive or object file path contains this text (case-insensitive).

project.description: The project: a public project's GitHub 'owner/repo' (no API key needed), or, with an API key, a project id or name from list_projects.

ref.description: The build: a full commit SHA, a SHA prefix (7+ characters), or a branch or tag name. Default: the head of the default branch.

region.description: Only this memory region, e.g. FLASH or RAM.

name: list_symbols
title: List symbols
